title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation and Adaptation to Old Age
brief_summary: Changes and limitations in the aging process affect adaptation to old age. It is important for women to adapt to the problems of old age, find a solution and cope. This study was aimed to determine the effect of progressive muscle relaxation exercises on the level of depression and adaptation to old women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 65 years and above,
* Do not have a diagnosis of dementia and psychiatric disease by the doctor and have a mini-mental test score of 23 and above,
* Being independent in practicing daily living activities
* There is no problem with communication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under the age of 65
* Being addicted in daily life activities
* Being diagnosed with dementia and psychiatric illness
* Mini-mental test score below 23
